contexts.text: To send them away () = that He wanted to depart from that perception.
A hind let loose () = the affection of natural truth in a free state. AC 6413.
He sent away his brethren () = a hiding; for to send away = to remove from himself, consequently to be no longer present with them.
Let My son go () = a command that they should abstain from infesting. AC 7092.

To let the people go = to leave those of the Spiritual Church. AC 7440. AC 7500. AC 7540. AC 7552. AC 7593. AC 7617. AC 7641. AC 7654. AC 7707. AC 7734. AC 7767. AC 7768. AC 7798. AC 7964. AC 8085. AC 8092. AC 8145.
For your transgressions was your mother put away () = when the Church departs from faith.
In the seventh year thou shalt... let it lie fallow () = the second state, when the man of the Church is in good, and thus in the tranquillity of peace. Explained.
